text: Mobile app development involves several important decisions. First, developers must consider responsive design, which ensures an app works well on different screen sizes and devices. Another key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one operating system and often offer better performance, while cross-platform apps work on multiple systems and can save time and money. After development, apps are usually published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Finally, performance is crucial: a fast, smooth app keeps users happy, while a slow one is quickly deleted.
